listing.name: Doom 3: Resurrection of Evil (classic) (dhewm3)
listing.summary: Use the official dhewm3 Windows player for classic Resurrection of Evil with your own base-game and expansion files. Keep its external profile backed up.

steps.title: Prepare your original game
steps.instruction: Before Play, copy only base/pak000.pk4 through base/pak008.pk4 from your own classic Doom 3 installation patched to 1.3.1 into the matching base folder beside dhewm3.exe on Windows or dhewm3 on Linux. Also copy your own Resurrection of Evil d3xp/pak000.pk4 and d3xp/pak001.pk4 into d3xp beside the player. Both the complete base game and expansion are required; the maintained launch arguments select d3xp. Keep the original installation separately. BFG Edition is a different product; do not copy its files or old engine executables/DLLs over this runtime. Prepare these files yourself and check the edition against the upstream instructions; Portcove does not verify their original-game identity. The official Windows player is 32-bit and runs on 64-bit Windows through Windows compatibility support. Keep the package's own DLLs and resources together. Its optional mods and widescreen-GUI downloads are separate; customized runtime or mod layouts can keep an external registration.

steps.title: Keep an existing prepared copy
steps.instruction: Keep a working custom copy registered with dhewm3.exe, its actual runtime folder as working directory, and its own launch details. To read originals from another installation, use three separate argument lines: +set, fs_basepath, then the absolute folder containing base and any d3xp data. Select Resurrection of Evil with three more separate lines: +set, fs_game, d3xp. You and upstream retain replacement and data ownership for that external copy; removing its registration preserves its files. This alternative does not make Portcove manage or migrate its originals, saves or runtime.

warnings: Back up that external profile and your original game separately before changing engines or versions.

references.title: Keep your saves and existing copy
references.instruction: Normal Windows saves, settings, screenshots, demos and logs are in your actual Documents/My Games/dhewm3 profile, with separate base and d3xp scopes. Back up that external profile and your original game separately before changing engines or versions. Existing customized copies keep their own launch details and runtime owner.

references.title: Choose your Linux setup
references.instruction: Choose the official dhewm3 amd64 or arm64 game tarball. Extract the complete folder and keep its game libraries. Place your classic Doom 3 v1.3.1 base/pak000.pk4 through base/pak008.pk4 and Resurrection of Evil d3xp/pak000.pk4 and d3xp/pak001.pk4 in matching folders. Start ./dhewm3 with +set fs_game d3xp from the prepared directory. Preserve ~/.config/dhewm3 and ~/.local/share/dhewm3 or their XDG equivalents, plus any custom paths. Install SDL2, OpenAL, libcurl and the GNU C++ and GCC runtime libraries through your distribution. The inspected ARM64 executable needs glibc 2.38. The managed Linux x86-64 copy reads your PK4s from its own runtime and starts with its packaged modules. Use a separate upstream copy for custom paths, native mods or a custom library search path.

references.title: Set up dhewm3 on Mac
references.instruction: Use the universal Mac Source Ports build linked from dhewm3.org. Copy dhewm3.app out of its disk image. Put your classic Doom 3 v1.3.1 base/pak000.pk4 through base/pak008.pk4 and Resurrection of Evil d3xp/pak000.pk4 and d3xp/pak001.pk4 in matching folders under ~/Library/Application Support/dhewm3. With the app closed and installed in Applications, run open -a /Applications/dhewm3.app --args +set fs_game d3xp in Terminal to select the expansion. Preserve that profile, its saves, and all original-data locations.

source_requirements.label: Classic Doom 3 1.3.1 with Resurrection of Evil

steps.title: Choose your original game folder
steps.instruction: Choose the folder containing base and d3xp from your own classic Doom 3 and Resurrection of Evil installation patched to 1.3.1. Portcove checks and prepares the base and expansion PK4 files, then you can select Play. BFG Edition is a different product. Keep your original installation separately. On Windows, keep the managed library path short and use plain ASCII. On Linux, keep the packaged modules and install SDL2, OpenAL, libcurl and the GNU C++ and GCC runtime libraries. Keep backups of the external save and settings folders. Use a separately prepared copy for custom paths or native mods.

warnings: Use a separately prepared copy for custom paths, native mods or a dedicated server. Keep backups of your external saves and settings.
